question: Describe what compost is made from and one stated use.
raw: O1: [S1] Compost is made from a mixture of green waste (nitrogen-rich materials such as leaves, grass, and food scraps) and brown waste (woody materials rich in carbon, such as stalks, paper, and wood chips). One stated use of compost is to improve soil fertility in gardens, landscaping, horticulture, urban agriculture, and organic farming, reducing dependency on commercial chemical fertilizers.
